message: Thanks. A few more questions: (1) How many people live in your household? (2) Is anyone 65 or older? (3) Roughly how much does the household earn from work per year before tax? (4) Any other income a year (Social Security, pensions, unemployment, etc.)? (5) Does anyone get health insurance through a job? (6) Roughly how much is in bank accounts and investments? (7) What do you pay for rent or mortgage each month?
reply: Two of us. Hard to say. About 300 thousand a year. None. I don't really know. I don't really know. $42,900. $900 a month.

summary: Two-person Arizona household, no kids, about $300k/yr earnings. Well above income limits for all ten programmes (including the ACA premium tax credit, which ends above 400% FPL in 2026). No recommendations.
